title: 第一卷 第2章 欠我的钱什么时候还？
slug: 全网黑上恋综后我爆红了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

主持人：“……”

宋尔尔心想，可以，这个更省字。

主持人不死心：“陆老师这次为什么会来参加我们的恋综呢？”

陆执语气平稳：“欠人情。”

主持人：“……”

宋尔尔没忍住，看了他一眼。

好家伙。

她以为自己已经够不装了。

没想到这位是精装房直接拆承重墙。

弹幕笑裂。

【哈哈哈哈一个因为违约金太贵，一个因为欠人情。】

【这节目还有真心嘉宾吗？】

【主持人：我带不动，我真的带不动。】

【陆执你被绑架了就眨眨眼。】

主持人终于放弃让嘉宾说漂亮话，开始cue流程。

“既然大家已经到齐，那我们先进行第一个环节。每位嘉宾需要选择一个信封，里面是节目组准备的问题。请大家根据问题回答，也方便彼此更快了解。”

工作人员端上来一个托盘。

宋尔尔站得最近，随手拿了一个。

纸条上写着：你理想中的另一半是什么样？

镜头立刻给了她特写。

主持人笑得非常期待：“尔尔的问题是理想型。这个问题很适合恋综，那尔尔可以和大家分享一下，你喜欢什么样的人？”

顾南舟微微坐直。

林栀看向她。

陆执也抬了下眼。

弹幕开始起哄。

【她肯定要说顾南舟那款。】

【倒贴姐名场面预定。】

【求她别碰瓷我家陆执。】

宋尔尔看着纸条，想了想。

“活的。”

主持人笑容一僵：“啊？”

宋尔尔补充：“男的。”

客厅里有人没憋住笑。

主持人艰难地问：“还有吗？”

宋尔尔很认真：“不借钱的。”

顾南舟：“……”

周闻野这次是真笑出了声。

姜眠赶紧捂住嘴。

陆执低头理了一下袖口，唇角很轻地动了一下。

弹幕已经笑疯了。

【活的，男的，不借钱的。要求不高，但很致命。】

【顾南舟：你报我身份证得了。】

【我要把这句话写进我的相亲条件。】

【宋尔尔怎么回事，我黑着黑着笑出声了。】

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

Host: "..."

Song Er'er thought, yes, this is more economical.

The host refused to give up: "Why did Teacher Lu come to participate in our love drama this time?"

Lu Zhi said calmly: "I owe you a favor."

Host: "..."

Song Er'er couldn't help it and glanced at him.

Good guy.

She thought she was done pretending.

Unexpectedly, this person directly removed the load-bearing wall in a fully decorated room.

The barrage burst into laughter.

[Hahahaha, one is because the liquidated damages are too expensive, and the other is because he owes a favor.】

[Are there any sincere guests on this show?】

[Host: I can’t carry it, I really can’t carry it.】

[Lu Zhi, just blink if you are kidnapped.】

The host finally gave up asking the guests to say nice things and started the cue process.

"Now that everyone is here, let's move on to the first session. Each guest needs to choose an envelope, which contains questions prepared by the program team. Please answer according to the questions, so that you can get to know each other faster."

The staff brought a tray.

Song Er'er stood closest and took one casually.

The note read: What is your ideal partner like?

The camera immediately gave her a close-up.

The host smiled with great anticipation: "Er'er's question is about the ideal type. This question is very suitable for romance. Can Er'er share with you, what kind of person do you like?"

Gu Nanzhou sat up straight slightly.

Lin Zhi looked at her.

Lu Zhi also raised his eyes.

The barrage started to boo.

[She would definitely say the Gu Nanzhou style.】

[Reservation of the scene where I posted my sister’s name.】

[Please don’t touch my Lu Zhi.】

Song Er'er looked at the note and thought for a while.

"Alive."

The host's smile froze: "Huh?"

Song Er'er added: "Male."

Someone in the living room couldn't hold back his laughter.

The host asked with difficulty: "Is there any more?"

Song Er'er was very serious: "I won't lend money."

Gu Nanzhou: "..."

Zhou Wenye really laughed out loud this time.

Jiang Mian quickly covered her mouth.

Lu Zhi lowered his head and straightened his sleeves, and the corners of his lips moved slightly.

The barrage was already laughing like crazy.

[Live, male, not lending money.Not demanding, but deadly.】

[Gu Nanzhou: Just give me your ID card.】

[I want to write this sentence into my blind date conditions.】

[What's going on with Song Er'er? I laughed out loud.】
